integrity: Analytical all-degree proof uses gradient identities, exact associated-Legendre equatorial values and positive rational inequalities. Python standard-library finite tests provide supplementary cross-checks.
scientific_limitations: Only a single exact-degree tangential vector-harmonic space on S^2 and a hemisphere. The general cap matrix and per-order blocks are prior methods, not the claimed advance. Jahn–Bokor full-text priority comparison incomplete; independent validation unperformed.
title: Sharp one-eighth hemisphere leakage for monochromatic tangential spherical harmonics
